title: An investigation of emotion dynamics in major depressive disorder patients and healthy persons using sparse longitudinal networks
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Data preprocessing steps strongly influenced results; - Sparse VAR model assumes homogeneity across individuals; - Raw coefficients used, which may be biased.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. The code is available from the first author. The data is available at the University of Groningen repository.
